source: Can we collect data about choices you make in the game? Choose NO (or don't answer) and we won't collect data. Choose YES and we'll use pseudonymised data to refine the game. source: I never completed my medical degree, though I learnt enough to set a bone and treat a fever. I was distracted by medicine's occult hinterlands. In 1927, Spencer was sponsored by the Suppression Bureau to study medicine. When that arrangement fell apart in 1930, he signed up for five years as a medical officer in the [[Légion du Seuil]].

source:
Knowledge of art, culture, life's finer material pleasures. The ability to pick up subtle references, or make clever ones. Though what for, exactly?

[This is the least useful [[Worldly Skill]], although it will, among other things, give Spencer some ability with languages other than the ones he speaks fluently - English, French and German.]
translation:
对艺术、文化，以及生活中种种精美物质享受的了解；看得懂微妙的暗示，也会巧妙地旁征博引。可这到底有何用？

[这是最没用的[[Worldly Skill]]。不过它至少能让斯宾塞略通几门英、法、德语以外的语言——这三门，他说得很流利。]
notes: 保留链接、方括号说明与两段结构；维持系统对该技艺的干涩自嘲。

source:
"Flint is gone; but her facets echoed each a separate Star. When the Forge is ashes, Flint shreds what remains." - attr. Thomas Dewulf

What's left of Spencer has surrendered to the night. Perhaps he'll descend into Nowhere. Perhaps he'll close his eyes and open the gates of his spirit. Whatever his hollow flesh does next, it won't be our story.

This is not a positive ending.
translation:
“燧石已逝；可她每一片晶面，都曾回响一颗不同的星。待铸化作灰烬，燧石将撕碎余物。”——传为托马斯·德伍尔夫所作

斯宾塞余下的一切已经归顺长夜。也许他会沉入虚界；也许他会闭上眼，敞开灵魂的门。无论这具空心血肉接下来做什么，都不再是我们的故事。

这不是一个好结局。
notes: Flint／Forge／Nowhere 按术语表译“燧石／铸／虚界”；保留三段结构、引文归属与冷峻疏离。

source:
Europe awaits --- Mimata, where the red nuns look down on the beasts of the town --- Caen, where the New King's catafalque smoulders --- Mahaggony, under its amber --- Berlin red-litten --- Prague, Cross-hived, with its stairway ever down --- and at last, your final destination.

You are the one who passes every door. CONJURE your new self. CONFESS your schemes. And just when they think they have the measure of you --- DISAPPEAR.

[Think someone else might enjoy this? Send them the link so they can wishlist it, or try the demo.]

欧洲正等着你——米马塔，红衣修女俯视城中群兽——卡昂，新王的灵柩台仍在阴燃——马哈戈尼，伏于琥珀之下——红光映照的柏林——布拉格，介壳种筑巢其间，阶梯永远向下——最后，才是你的终点。

你是穿过每一扇门的人。召出新的自己。吐露你的谋划。就在他们自以为看透你时——消失。
